description: Widening of National Highways and reconstruction of road infrastructure facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited following the national competitive procurement method for the selection of contractors to improve several road sections under the widening and improvement of National Highways Programme and the Programme for the Reconstruction and Improvement of roads damaged by the cyclone Ditwah. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committees, following the evaluation of the bids so received, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contracts to the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidders, as follows:
